Instrument (EN): Professional Quality of Life Scale, Version 5
Scales / measured domains (EN): Compassion satisfaction (10); Burnout (10); Secondary traumatic stress (10)
EN form: EN original 30 item self-report; Stamm 2010 manual
ES form: ES original translated forms available; no EN norm transfer
Other translations: Other language forms must be validated separately
Target population: Adult helping professionals exposed to client distress
Commercial digital use / permission revi: Owner CVT permits no-charge copying/reformatting if attribution, unchanged text and measure not sold; permission for bundled commercial SaaS service and translated versions needs written clarification.
Verification notes / safety gate: Do NOT produce one aggregate ProQOL score; developer cautions percentile cutoffs and diagnostic claims. Reference only, not runnable.

Instrument (EN): Professional Quality of Life — Russian adaptation (Pankratova & Nikolaeva 2023)
Question count: 30 (source V5 form; Russian item-level equivalence still to verify)
Scales / measured domains (EN): Job satisfaction; Occupational satisfaction; Secondary trauma; Burnout; higher-order compassion satisfaction/fatigue
RU form: RU independently factor-analysed 2023 n=304 counseling psychologists; four factors, not 3
ES form: ES NOT established from Russian study
Target population: Russian-speaking adult counseling psychologists (n=304 in validation)
Commercial digital use / permission revi: Author/translator permission and exact Russian items, scoring, norms required; original ProQOL permission does not automatically extend to adapted RU scoring or branded commercial digital deployment.
Verification notes / safety gate: RU version has 4 primary factors vs original 3; 30-item count inherited from V5 and needs direct article form confirmation. Do not substitute original scoring.

Instrument (EN): Professional Quality of Life — French child-protection psychometric evaluation
Question count: 30 (original V5 item count; local item list verify)
Scales / measured domains (EN): Compassion satisfaction; Burnout; Secondary traumatic stress; bifactor/general factor proposed
EN form: EN V5 original; local factors not equivalent
ES form: ES not assessed in this FR study
Other translations: FR psychometric evaluation 2019 n=310 French-speaking Canadian child-protection workers; proposed bifactor; original 3-factor CFA FAILED
Commercial digital use / permission revi: Verify copyright/translation-holder permission; no commercial e-form authorization independently established.
Verification notes / safety gate: FR assessed, NOT validated for original 3-factor scoring. Single general factor is study-specific proposal conflicting with V5 developer guidance. Research-only.

Instrument (EN): Professional Quality of Life — 21-item Rasch revision
Scales / measured domains (EN): Compassion satisfaction; Compassion fatigue (combined burnout/secondary-trauma items); revised norms
EN form: EN Australian registered nurses n=1615, Rasch revised 2018
RU form: RU exact 21-item independent validation not found
ES form: ES exact 21-item independent validation not found
Target population: Adult nurses/caring professionals, tested in Australian nurses
Commercial digital use / permission revi: Article CC BY does not automatically grant rights for altered/proprietary original items, digital commercial scoring, and norms; verify with developers and CVT.
Verification notes / safety gate: Distinct 21-item model, NOT same item set / scoring as ProQOL-V5 30; originally three-scale burnout/STS structure showed weaknesses.

Instrument (EN): Short Professional Quality of Life Scale — selected version IV items
EN form: EN V4 parent version only; nine-item research version directly tested in ES/PT
ES form: ES Spain n385 and Argentina n273 from study1, invariance investigated
Other translations: PT-BR n161 (Brazil) study1, official Portuguese V4 item source; not ES version
Target population: Palliative-care healthcare professionals, psychologists, nurses and physicians; three countries (n=817)
Commercial digital use / permission revi: Shortening/selected items constitutes an adapted edition; article CC BY licence does not by itself settle ProQOL item reuse in commercial SaaS; ask CVT/authors.
Verification notes / safety gate: Not interchangeable with Short ProQOL version V because item wording/response conventions differ. Model fit had elevated RMSEA.

Instrument (EN): Short Professional Quality of Life Scale — version V, Spanish validation
EN form: EN parent V5 reference; nine items translated for ES study
ES form: ES study2 Spanish palliative-care workers n=296; forward/back translation + CFA/reliability 2020
Other translations: Not automatically validated for Portuguese or Latin-American Spanish versions
Commercial digital use / permission revi: CVT ProQOL and short-form author permission for commercial online use unresolved; article publication ≠ questionnaire licence.
Verification notes / safety gate: Distinct V5-based 9-item edition. RMSEA .126 despite other indices/reliability acceptable; no diagnostic cutoffs or original ProQOL norms.

Instrument (EN): Secondary Traumatic Stress Scale — Bride, Robinson, Yegidis & Figley
Scales / measured domains (EN): Intrusion; Avoidance; Arousal (work-related secondary exposure to trauma)
EN form: EN original 2004 and validation n=275 social workers; further 2021 victim advocates n=135
RU form: RU exact validated edition not verified
ES form: ES Bride STSS 17 exact validation not confirmed; Mexican 2011/2013 ETS has DIFFERENT dimensions, NOT same scale
Target population: Trauma-exposed adult social workers and victim advocates
Commercial digital use / permission revi: SAGE/Bride item and scoring reuse rights for commercial SaaS not shown; obtain written permissions.
Verification notes / safety gate: Do not conflate Bride STSS with Mexican Cuestionario de Estrés Traumático Secundario measuring emotional fatigue, symptoms, shattered beliefs.

Scales / measured domains (EN): Work burnout (8); Secondary trauma (5); combined compassion fatigue
EN form: EN 2008 social-workers post urban disaster, 13-item short form evaluated
RU form: RU no independently validated exact form verified
ES form: ES no independently validated exact form verified
Target population: Adult social workers, disaster aftermath and related helpers
Commercial digital use / permission revi: Open-access study does not establish separate permission to republish questionnaires inside commercial SaaS; author/SAGE review needed.
Verification notes / safety gate: Not same as ProQOL compassion fatigue 10-item subscale; CFSS short = 8+5. Occupational self-report, no diagnosis.

Scales / measured domains (EN): Professional fulfillment (6); Work exhaustion (4); Interpersonal disengagement (6)
RU form: RU translation may be online but independent validated exact edition NOT established

Verification notes / safety gate: Physician-specific items should not be silently replaced with 'clients'; changing wording invalidates original norms and requires permission.

Instrument (EN): Stanford Professional Fulfillment Index — Brazilian Portuguese adaptation
Scales / measured domains (EN): Professional fulfillment (6); Work exhaustion (4); Interpersonal disengagement (6)
RU form: RU independently validated form not found
ES form: ES not established by Portuguese Brazil study

Instrument (EN): Stanford Professional Fulfillment Index — Japanese validation
Scales / measured domains (EN): Professional fulfillment (6); Work exhaustion (4); Interpersonal disengagement (6)
RU form: RU exact validated form not found
ES form: ES exact validated form not confirmed
Other translations: JA 2023 Tokyo Univ independent evaluation n=666 healthcare workers; original 3-factor EFA; CFA fit modest
Target population: Japanese-speaking physicians, nurses and other disaster-response healthcare professionals

Instrument (EN): Mini Z 2.0 — workplace burnout and drivers of stress
Scales / measured domains (EN): Burnout single-item; job satisfaction; stress; control; teamwork; work chaos; values alignment; EHR burden
RU form: RU exact validated 2.0 edition not found
ES form: ES exact validated 2.0 edition not found
Commercial digital use / permission revi: Hennepin Healthcare Institute for Professional Worklife: free for education/research/program evaluation; commercial/revenue-generating use requires permission.
Verification notes / safety gate: Do not confuse Mini Z with one-item burnout screen or Mini ReZ 15. Not an independent diagnostic burnout scale.

Scales / measured domains (EN): Core Mini Z (10) plus interruptions; sleep impairment; support-staff relations; peer support; recognition
EN form: EN original resident derivation n1792; validation n1097 (2019–2021 cohorts)
Commercial digital use / permission revi: Research/education use permitted by authors; commercial revenue-generating use of Mini Z derivative requires Hennepin Healthcare permission.
Verification notes / safety gate: Contains 10 core questions + 5 resident-specific items; strictly keep edition-specific weighting, no client-facing launch.

Instrument (EN): Stanford Self-Valuation Scale — physician self-care and learning from mistakes
Scales / measured domains (EN): Constructive self-valuation; self-care prioritization; response to errors / growth mindset
EN form: EN 2019 US physician sample n3899 respondents; 4 items 0–4
RU form: RU exact validated edition not found
ES form: ES exact validated edition not found
Target population: Physicians at US academic medical centers
Commercial digital use / permission revi: Stanford lists Self-Valuation among permission-managed instruments; for commercial SaaS obtain Stanford author permission; published paper copyrighted Elsevier.
Verification notes / safety gate: The scale tests physician self-valuation, not a generic patient self-compassion score. Profession-specific validation needed.

Question count: 9 (current Mayo web self-check; confirm exact edition against 2016 eWBI)
Scales / measured domains (EN): Occupational distress; fatigue; burnout; quality of life; professional-risk flags
EN form: EN Mayo Clinic WBI 9-item modern platform; 2016 worker sample 5392 plus physicians n6880 evaluated eWBI
RU form: RU no independently validated exact nine-item form identified
ES form: ES no independently validated exact nine-item form identified

Commercial digital use / permission revi: Mayo Clinic WBI is a proprietary hosted/commercial assessment platform; no permission to clone questionnaire/scoring/benchmarks.

Instrument (EN): Professional Self-Care Scale — Galiana Spanish validation
Scales / measured domains (EN): Physical self-care (3); Inner self-care (3); Social self-care (3)
EN form: EN article summary not a validated English version
